witness_review.branch: Intentional stop with a rear-driver recipient
required_context: Construct a stopping destination on a supported one-way route.
Document the rear vehicle's driver, longitudinal and lateral position, gap and motion without imposing a legal distance or same-lane rule.
Establish ordinary vehicle classification and actual driver control.
Establish ordinary vehicle classification and driver physical control.
Establish whether conflict avoidance or official directions caused any halt.
Preserve uncertainty about signal appropriateness and the prohibited-stopping definition's application; document conflict and official-direction context.
Retain actual displayed signal and visibility from the rear driver's location.
Retain actual signal display, timing and visibility from the rear driver's position.
Specify a supported one-way approach and destination stopping footprint.
Specify the other vehicle's driver, position, motion and rearward relationship.
witness_review.reason: The one-way road permits a destination stop with another driver positioned to the rear.
